name: Global Top E-Commerce Co., Ltd.
summary: Global Top E-Commerce Co., Ltd. operates as a cross-border e-commerce company in the People's Republic of China and internationally. It offers clothing, home furnishings, accessories, maternal and child products, and health care products through online sales platforms, such as Zaful. The company also provides swimwear, women's wear, dresses, and trousers and similar items. It also exports its products. The company was formerly known as Shanxi Baiyuan Trousers Chain Management Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Global Top E-Commerce Co., Ltd. in June 2015.Global Top E-Commerce Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Taiyuan, the People's Republic of China.
